originals.why: Natural North Welsh. 'deud' is used in the sense this LEGO teaches, with an embedded question after it.

originals.ko: 그들은 그녀의 이름이 뭔지 말하지 않았어
originals.why: Natural. 'deud' plus an embedded question, the same sense this LEGO teaches.

originals.ko: 그들은 그 모든 게 어떻게 시작됐는지 말하지 않았어
originals.why: Natural and idiomatic. 'sut wnaeth y cwbl ddechrau' works as an embedded clause after deud.

originals.ko: 그들은 그게 고장 났다고 말하지 않았어
originals.why: Natural. 'deud fod...' is the reported-speech use of the same 'say' sense, and it matches the ~라고 gloss exactly.
